description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter app implementing a Tic Tac Toe game with Ocean Professional styling. It contains the main widget, game logic, UI components, and styling configuration.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring the app's theme and home page.

classes.name: GamePage
classes.description: Main game widget managing state, game logic, and UI rendering.

classes.name: _ResultBanner
classes.description: Displays game result (win/draw) with styled banner.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Widget representing a single cell in the game grid with animation.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game board and state for a new round, preserving user symbol choice.

methods.name: newGameWithSelection
methods.description: Resets the game and prompts for symbol selection.

methods.name: _updateGameStatus
methods.description: Checks board for a win or draw after each move.

methods.name: _playerColor
methods.description: Returns color associated with a player (X or O).
